main_text.p: çonfulo. Item,'apium, quod hortenfe pe-trofelinum effe,non pauci herbarij noftra-tes exiftimant, vitandum eft, ceu naturali-ter comitiales offendens. A' fructibus vero cavere admodum epilepticis falubre eft. Sin autem,voluptatis gratia,ijs vefci cupiant, modici afferantur,& maxime à cibo. Nam tum minus nocebunt. Omnia quoq; bellaria refpuant praeter piftacia,& vvas paffas, quae fuper cibu fumantur. Placentis omnino abftineant,ut contufis, quae ftrobili nucleos recipiant. Quae vero ex amygdalis & piftacijs copofita funt,admittantur ut quae vim quandam purgandi pituitam obtineant. Vinum quoq;, quo ad affectum attiner, prorfus circumcidendum eft,& praecipue vetuftum, quod caput nimio pere repleat, & fpiritus,humoresque cerebri cieat. Atfi adeo imbecillus fit vetriculus,ut cibus coquere nequeat, tum ab aegro mediocriter potabitur,& maxime quod abfinthites dicitur. Nec nutrici cenfeo vinu effe omnino interdicendu,ut quide noftri temporis doctifsimi medici fcriptu reliquerunt, fed illi mediocriter bibendu fuadeo: lac enim atte nvabit,& ab ichorib. expurgabit, fi albu fit & tenue. page.notes: Spelling kept as printed where it differs from classical forms (çonfulo, Atfi, cenfeo, fuadeo, nutrici, abfinthites, bibendu, copofita). Long s normalised to plain s and u/v adjusted per the rules (vero, vetuftum, vvas, vitandum, cavere, voluptatis, vefci, vim, vinu, ventriculi, Iuvabit, suadeo, attenvabit). The word "attenvabit" is printed as "atte" / "nuabit" across a line end with no hyphen, so it is written whole. Catchword "ctionem." completes "coco-ctionem" and is set apart at the lower right. Printed "ant.Vinum", "dicitur.Nec", "Quae" and "tenue.Iuuabit" run together without spaces, as in the scan.
